yaml:
# W3-1 fixture: a cache entry big enough that its RESTORE STREAM can be torn.
#
# WHY A SECOND CACHE FIXTURE EXISTS. `cache-user.yaml` (job `edge-cache-user`)
# caches a single `deps/marker` file — a ~200-byte tar+zstd archive. That is
# enough to prove a hit crosses agents (which is what Task 3 built it for) and
# useless for W3-1, whose whole mechanism is an object DELETE landing while a
# cache-restore GET stream is still open: a 200-byte body is delivered in one
# TCP segment and there is no window at all.
#
# THE WIDTH KNOB IS PAYLOAD SIZE PLUS `inject.sh s3-slow`, deliberately, and
# NOT `s3-latency`. `s3-latency` adds a fixed pre-request connect delay, which
# widens the gap BEFORE the body starts and does nothing to the body itself;
# `s3-slow` is nginx `limit_rate` on the RESPONSE body, which is exactly the
# in-flight-GET window this scenario needs to hold open. 256 x 64 KiB of
# /dev/urandom = 16 MiB that zstd cannot compress, so the archive is ~16 MiB
# on the wire; at `s3-slow 262144` that is a ~64 s stream.
#
# THE `wipe` STEP IS LOAD-BEARING AND MUST STAY FIRST, for the same reason it
# is in `cache-user.yaml`: the host agent keeps a persistent per-job workspace
# (working<slot>/<job>), so without the wipe a second run would find `deps/`
# still populated from the first and every "restored" claim below would be
# unfalsifiable.
#
# THE FILE LAYOUT IS THE MEASUREMENT INSTRUMENT.
#   * `f0001`..`f0256`, each exactly 65536 bytes — so "how much of the archive
#     was extracted before the stream died" is a file count and a byte total,
#     not an impression.
#   * `zz-COMPLETE`, which sorts LAST and therefore is the LAST entry in the
#     tar (internal/artifact StreamTarZstd walks the tree in lexical order).
#     Its presence means the whole archive was extracted; its absence with a
#     non-zero file count means the extract was TORN.
#
# `inspect_deps` DELIBERATELY REGENERATES ONLY ON A COMPLETE MISS (zero
# entries). On a torn restore it leaves the half-populated directory exactly as
# `extract` left it and reports it. That is not laziness — it is the point:
# the deferred cache save (orchestrator.go:984-1001) then re-archives whatever
# is on disk under the SAME key, so a torn restore is measurable all the way
# through to the state of the cache entry the NEXT run gets.
#
# ttlDays: 1 is the floor. `0` is silently rewritten to 30
# (internal/agent/orchestrator.go:980-982); `<0` and `>365` are rejected
# (internal/dsl/parse.go:614-619).
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-cache-torn
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: wipe
      run: |
        rm -rf deps
        echo "WIPE-DONE $(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ) deps-present=$(test -e deps && echo yes || echo no)"

    - name: restore_deps
      cache:
        path: deps/
        key: edge-cache-torn-v1
        restoreKeys:
          - edge-cache-torn-
        ttlDays: 1

    - name: inspect_deps
      run: |
        echo "INSPECT-START $(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)"
        n=0
        if [ -d deps ]; then n=$(ls -1 deps 2>/dev/null | wc -l); fi
        c=no
        if [ -f deps/zz-COMPLETE ]; then c=yes; fi
        b=0
        if [ -d deps ]; then b=$(du -sb deps 2>/dev/null | cut -f1); fi
        echo "STATE entries=$n complete=$c bytes=$b"
        if [ "$n" -eq 0 ]; then
          echo "CACHE-MISS"
          mkdir -p deps
          i=1
          while [ "$i" -le 256 ]; do
            head -c 65536 /dev/urandom > "deps/f$(printf %04d "$i")"
            i=$((i+1))
          done
          date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ > deps/zz-COMPLETE
          echo "GENERATED entries=$(ls -1 deps | wc -l) bytes=$(du -sb deps | cut -f1) planted-at=$(cat deps/zz-COMPLETE)"
        else
          echo "CACHE-PRESENT complete=$c"
          echo "FIRST=$(ls -1 deps | head -1) LAST=$(ls -1 deps | tail -1)"
          short=0
          for f in deps/f*; do
            s=$(wc -c < "$f")
            if [ "$s" -ne 65536 ]; then
              short=$((short+1))
              echo "SHORT-FILE $f $s"
            fi
          done
          echo "SHORT-FILES=$short"
          if [ "$c" = yes ]; then echo "planted-at=$(cat deps/zz-COMPLETE)"; fi
        fi
        echo "INSPECT-END $(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ)"
